topic: ML results and data release plan
summary_markdown:
A review of ML results was conducted, noting that Mall performance was 45% higher without lockdown compared to lockdown data. Rail and Metro showed similar increases (3 times bigger). It was noted that local data for several months in 2020 is unavailable, requiring model predictions if historical calculation is pursued.

**Decisions:**
* The current models will be released on January 18th without recalculating historical data for 2020. Recalculation of 2020 data will only occur upon request from AFA.
* Changes in the data for Rail, Metro, and Mall categories must be explained to AFA.
* A separate model for lockdown is not required at this time.
